cards.text: One day Jesus is praying in private, and His disciples are with Him. Big crowds have been following Him (Luke 9:11). Me? The biggest crowd I ever drew was a twist tie and two dead batteries in the junk drawer I used to live in.

cards.question: Jesus is praying in private, and His disciples are with Him. What does He ask them first?

answers.text: Who the crowds say He is
Which of them is the greatest

cards.text: The disciples have heard what people are saying about Jesus, and the answers are all over the place. It's like asking the group chat to pick one movie: nine opinions, zero movies.

cards.question: Some people in the crowds say Jesus is John the Baptist, the man who went around the Jordan preaching baptism (Luke 3:3).

cards.text: Others say He's Elijah, the prophet from long ago (1 Kings 18:36), and still others say a prophet of old has arisen. Everybody's got a theory, friend.
Then Jesus turns it around: “Who do you say I am?” Oh, NOW it's personal, like when the meeting goes around the table and suddenly it's YOUR turn.

cards.question: The crowds have their theories. Then Peter, one of the disciples, answers that Jesus is the ___ of God.

cards.text: Peter just said something HUGE. Then Jesus tells the disciples what to do with it.

cards.question: After Peter says Jesus is the Christ of God, Jesus tells the disciples to go tell everyone.

cards.text: Then Jesus talks about the Son of Man, a name He uses for Himself (Luke 5:24). He says the Son of Man must suffer many things.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man must suffer many things. Who does He say will reject Him?

answers.text: The elders and chief priests and scribes
The Roman governor and his soldiers
The tax collectors and the sinners

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man must be killed. What does He say happens on the third day?

answers.text: He will be raised to life
The temple will be torn down

cards.text: Then Jesus tells all of them what it takes to come after Him. And friend, He does NOT hide it in the fine print.

cards.question: Jesus says whoever wants to come after Him must deny himself, follow Him and take something up daily. What is it?

cards.text: Then Jesus says what happens to whoever wants to save his life.

cards.question: Jesus says whoever wants to save his life will keep it.
Jesus says whoever loses his life for His sake will save it.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks a question about gaining the WHOLE world. Friend, I celebrate for a WEEK when one batch comes out of the oven with every cookie the same size.

cards.question: Jesus asks what it profits a man to gain the whole world. What does He say that man could lose or forfeit?

cards.text: Then Jesus talks about anyone who is ashamed of Him and His words.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man will be ashamed of anyone who is ashamed of Him and His words. When does He say that will happen?

answers.text: When He comes in His glory
When He goes up the mountain

cards.question: The Son of Man comes in His own glory. Whose glory does Jesus say He comes in too?

answers.text: The Father and the holy angels

cards.text: Then Jesus opens with “But I tell you truly,” and friend, when He starts like THAT, me and my gold base lean in TOGETHER. He's talking about some of the people standing right there.

cards.question: Jesus says some of the people standing there will not taste death before they see something. What is it?
